quotes.quote: To realize your imagination, go with trust in the direction of your destination.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Isn't it a good thing we don't know everything? If we did, we wouldn't have a reason to have curiosity, and curiosity is like imagination, taking us back to the time when we were just children in our own fantasylands.
quotes.author: Jule Warner

quotes.quote: In my imagination, this world is an amazingly beautiful, peaceful, loving and kind.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Our imagination is bigger than this universe.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: To grow the power of an imagination, travel to see the world.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: You are the storyteller and the editor of your book of life. So write tales of imagination, tragedy, and adventure and illustrate it with the colors of beauty.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Like imagination, consciousness has no limits.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: The limits of your imagination create the boundaries of your world.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: The mind is so powerful that is can suddenly grow wings of imagination and fly in the open sky.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: When you are very rational, you may not be able to dream or live in a fairy tale.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Imagination is a process of seeing events or things with the minds eye.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Consciousness makes you an unlimited being by giving the power of your imagination.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: To find the nectar of life, let me get lost in the mysteries and beauties of the imagination.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely
